name: parsinegar.settings
description: Parsinegar user preferences: theme, document direction and editor font size over pey.storage.service

provides.name: parsinegar.settings.service
provides.description: Validated user preferences with defaults; single preferences record.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Reads the stored preferences merged over defaults; missing record returns defaults.

methods.name: saveSettings
methods.description: Validates the patch, merges it over current settings, stores and publishes settings:changed.
